import java.util.*;

        int u, v;
        long capacity, flow;
        long cost;
        Edge(int u, int v, long capacity, long flow, long cost) {
            this.u = u;
            this.v = v;
            this.capacity = capacity;
            this.flow = flow;
            this.cost = cost;
        }
        long remaining() {
            return capacity - flow;
        }

    static ArrayList<Integer>[] g;

    static void addEdge(int u, int v, long cap, long cost) {

        e.add(new Edge(u, v, cap, 0, cost));
        g[v].add(e.size());
        e.add(new Edge(v, u, 0, 0, -cost));
    }

    static void minCostFlow(int s, int t) {
        Arrays.fill(inQueue, false);
        flow = 0;
        totalCost = 0;
        while (true) {
            Arrays.fill(dist, Long.MAX_VALUE);
            dist[s] = 0;
            Arrays.fill(pre, -1);
            pre[s] = 0;
            Arrays.fill(cap, 0);
            cap[s] = Long.MAX_VALUE;
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            q.offer(s);
            inQueue[s] = true;
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int u = q.poll();

                        pre[edge.v] = idx;

                        if (!inQueue[edge.v]) {

                            inQueue[edge.v] = true;
                        }
                    }

            if (pre[t] < 0) break;

            }
        }
    }
